summary: Iteration 5: End-to-end backend testing of Google Play Store compliant account-deletion feature. 15/15 pytest cases pass (100%). Coverage: SA + DELETE-TEST admin login, public deletion-request submission (validation + success), Super Admin deletion-request listing & processing, member self-deletion via DELETE /api/auth/me (wrong/missing/correct password, anonymization, cannot re-login), last-admin protection (block + unblock after adding a 2nd admin), payment history preservation after member anonymization. All 10 items of the review_request PASS. No critical or minor issues found in the deletion feature. Existing suite unrelated: 1 failure in test_health_and_auth.py::test_admin_login_success due to stale TEST-NEW-DB admin credentials (outside review scope).

review_scope_validation.3_delete_me_rejects_wrong_password: PASS - DELETE /api/auth/me {password:'WRONG'} → 401, error 'Mot de passe incorrect'. Missing password → 400.
review_scope_validation.4_delete_me_anonymizes_member: PASS - DELETE with correct password → 200. User email replaced by compte-supprime-<8>@deleted.local, active=false, phone=null, passwordHash rotated. Member name replaced by 'Membre supprimé (<8>)', active=false.
review_scope_validation.5_delete_me_blocks_last_admin: PASS - Created ephemeral association with a single admin, self-delete → 400 'Vous êtes le dernier administrateur...'. After adding a second admin via SA, first admin can self-delete (200).
review_scope_validation.6_deleted_account_cannot_login: PASS - After DELETE, POST /api/auth/login with original email/password → 401 (identifiants invalides / compte désactivé).
review_scope_validation.7_payment_history_preserved: PASS - Created member, created year (2099), recorded payment, deleted member's account. GET /api/payments/year/:yearId still returns payload (payments row not deleted; only User+Member anonymized).
review_scope_validation.8_get_public_associations: PASS - GET /api/public/associations → 200 array of {code, name} including ASCB, TEST-NEW-DB, DELETE-TEST. Only 'code' & 'name' fields exposed (no id/type leak).
review_scope_validation.9_post_public_deletion_request: PASS - Validation: missing email+phone → 400, missing associationCode → 400, unknown code → 404. Valid payload → 201 with requestId, status='pending'.
review_scope_validation.10_get_platform_deletion_requests: PASS - Requires SA auth (unauth → 401). SA GET returns full list ordered by createdAt desc, including the newly-created request. PUT /:id with {status:'processed'} → 200 with processedBy=SA email + processedAt. Invalid status → 400.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.js DELETE /me implementation is solid: password re-verification, last-admin guard, transactional-ish anonymization (User + linked Member), password hash rotated to a random value to invalidate future guesses, token cleared. Aligned with GDPR-style anonymization to preserve accounting history.

routes/public.js instantiates a new PrismaClient() locally instead of reusing the shared prisma export from middleware/auth.js. This creates an additional connection pool at startup and is a subtle resource leak — recommend importing { prisma } from '../middleware/auth.js' as done in the other route files.

routes/public.js POST /deletion-request has no rate-limit / captcha; the endpoint is public and could be abused to spam the deletion_requests table. Consider adding basic per-IP throttling and/or a honeypot field for the web form.

routes/platform.js PUT /deletion-requests/:id does not validate that the requested id exists before calling prisma.deletionRequest.update — a bad id will surface as a raw 500 from Prisma P2025. Recommend catching P2025 and returning 404.

routes/auth.js DELETE /me only anonymizes the User + Member. Downstream tables that reference the user by userId (e.g., vehicles, exceptional payments) may still contain the original name/plate. Consider cascading anonymization or documenting which tables are intentionally retained for the association's accounting.

No 'deletion audit' trail: after DELETE /api/auth/me, the reason/source (mobile app vs SA-processed public form) is not recorded. Adding a row in deletion_requests with status='processed' from within DELETE /me would give a unified log for Play Store audits.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 pytest cases for deletion feature). Legacy suite unrelated: 1 fail in test_health_and_auth.py::test_admin_login_success due to stale TEST-NEW-DB admin password – outside review scope.

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral data cleaned up in-flight: (a) one deletion_request row via POST /api/public/deletion-request then immediately marked 'processed' via SA; (b) one anonymized MEMBER user under DELETE-TEST (compte-supprime-*@deleted.local, active=false) – left in DB by design since anonymization is the SUT; (c) one ephemeral association 'DEL-<HEX>' with lonely admin, then a second admin added, then cascade-deleted at end of TestDeleteLastAdminProtection.test_cleanup; (d) one year 2099 + payment in DELETE-TEST, year is deleted at end of TestPaymentHistoryPreserved.
